architectures.feedforward: Linear(9,64), ReLU, Linear(64,52), ReLU, Linear(52,5); biases
architectures.recurrent: one-layer biased GRU(input=9,hidden=32), Linear(32,5) with bias

shuffle: seeded whole-group permutation each epoch; all four complete resident sequences stay together
checkpoint_selection: lowest validation nonforced group-balanced NLL; exact ties choose earliest epoch

emission.name: zero/maximum-inflated beta-binomial
emission.legal_support: 0,...,floor(observed offer), without epsilon or upward rounding
emission.forced: n=0 has P(0)=1, zero primary loss, and retained observation history
emission.overlap: beta-binomial includes both endpoints; overlapping mixture masses are added

primary_score: mean nonforced choice NLL within each group, mean groups within mechanism, equal mean over four mechanisms
bin_closure: lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive; final upper edge included
seed_aggregation: equal mean of group scores over all three seeds; no lucky seed selection
uncertainty: paired mechanism-stratified group bootstrap; same resampled groups for every model
rollout_sampling: independent resident draws conditional on simultaneous pre-decision observations and separate histories
rollout_padding: zero pool/offers/returns/surplus after exact-zero termination; cumulative surplus held constant
rollout_parameters: best-validation weights frozen during play; recurrent states reset per independent game
representative_display: recurrent training seed 17, Equal; nearest median surplus with stable rollout-index tie break
held_out_status: held out from Task 03 fitting/selection, previously described by Task 01; no cross-group participant linkage available
transfer_boundary: Experiments 2-3 remain outside preparation, fitting, selection, and outcome inspection; Experiment 4 deferred
